label: THE FOUNDER
name: Ms. Sumi Rengaraj
paragraphs: An international entrepreneur and wellness practitioner, Ms. Sumi Rengaraj brings together her expertise in business, psychology, and holistic wellness. As a Yoga and Pranayama Instructor and Certified Emotional Intelligence Practitioner, she is passionate about nurturing emotional well-being, mindful living, and a healthier, more connected community.

As the founder of Sphere Women, her vision is to bring holistic wellness practices back into the community, reconnecting people with the ancient wisdom and healing traditions rooted in India. Through Sphere, she aspires to share these time-honoured practices with the world, giving back to the community and nurturing a deeper connection between people, nature, and the earth. Her mission is to make wellness accessible, meaningful, and an integral part of everyday life.
